verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document device pairing or per-connection approval before a new device can view or control the host screen. Several related controls exist, but none is this capability: hosts can limit which apps approved guests may see, MFA protects account login, and Teams admins can provision guest or member access. Link sharing is described as letting a team member observe or take control, with no approval step mentioned.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
